easy.statement_latex: An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of measure $114^\circ$. Determine the measure of the inscribed angle.
hints: The **Inscribed Angle Theorem**: an inscribed angle is half the measure of its intercepted arc.
Use the formula $\theta = \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot (\text{arc})$.
Compute: $\dfrac{114}{2} = 57^\circ$.
solution_steps_latex: Apply the Inscribed Angle Theorem: inscribed angle $= \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot$ intercepted arc.
